layouts.name: Talladega Gran Prix
layouts.description: Full course selected from the complete closed OpenStreetMap way1061184414v1, compared with native satellite imagery and the operator facility map. Internal circulation shortcuts in the prior provisional cycle are excluded. Coordinates remain exact retained source nodes; no nominal length or width fit. Direction follows the operator map. Source geometry remains draft; border and terrain limits remain estimates.
